categories.OOM: container killed for exceeding its memory limit
categories.APP_CRASH: the application itself exits or panics (bad config, missing dependency, code error)
categories.IMAGE: the image cannot be pulled (wrong tag, auth, registry)
categories.SCHEDULING: the pod cannot be placed on a node (resources, taints, affinity, quotas)
categories.STORAGE: volume, PVC, mount or disk problems
categories.NETWORK: DNS, service connectivity, timeouts between components
